title: cyanea lanceolata subsp. calycina
intro: Cyanea lanceolata subsp. calycina, commonly known as the Hawaiian Willow, is a flowering plant native to the Hawaiian Islands. The plant is used in traditional Hawaiian medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Cyanea lanceolata subsp. calycina include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a valuable resource in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
